author: PeterSchiff
text: Trump claims that the $5,000 "dividend" is going to happen 100 percent, "because our country is taking in trillions and trillions of dollars." But that's another lie. Our country is losing trillions and trillions. Nearly $4 trillion since Trump took office for the second time.
